subject: Architecture
title: Shanghai Tower: The Twist That Saves Millions
description: A quick, practical guide to Shanghai Tower: The Twist That Saves Millions.

hook.text: Shanghai Tower spirals 120 degrees from base to top — and that twist isn't just for looks.

buildup.text: At 2,073 feet, it's the world's second-tallest building and China's tallest completed structure.

discovery.text: The spiral shape channels rainwater down the facade for collection and reuse inside the building.

twist.text: Nine sky gardens between the inner tower and outer glass skin create buffer zones that reduce heating costs.

climax.text: The twist reduces wind load by 24%, saving $58 million in steel — beauty that pays for itself.

punchline.text: The twist saves steel, collects rain, and grows gardens. Form follows savings.
